meaning.en: Forward a selected HTTP method and opaque request bytes through Session to an explicitly supported peer API, using Session’s extracted actor and selectively delegated permissions.
meaning.fa: ارسال روش HTTP و بدنهٔ درخواست از مسیر نشست به رابط سرویس همکار با هویت استخراج‌شدهٔ نشست و مجوزهای محدود واگذارشده.

scope.configuration_requirement: Explicit project peers and namespace reconciliation are required before claiming isolation; absent Asset/Profile URLs use the system namespace.

inputs_filters.method: Axum ANY; SDK exposes nine standard methods and requires an explicit CONNECT-capable adapter. This is not proof that every peer accepts all nine.
inputs_filters.path: Axum String path; SDK rejects empty/dot/encoded/traversal/query/fragment/backslash components and retains nested slashes.
inputs_filters.query: Original raw query forwarded unchanged; names/defaults/filters belong to the target API.
inputs_filters.body: Read at most 2MiB; body read/limit failure maps to413. Group creation may rewrite member_ids.
inputs_filters.cookie: Forwarded only when service != chat. x-user-id/roles/permissions are reconstructed from Session extractor context; caller headers are not directly forwarded.
inputs_filters.request_timeout: main middleware20s by default; matching Chat AI message POST300s. Router-only acceptance must not be described as whole-main timeout acceptance.

permissions.generic: No additional universal target permission gate in this proxy. Downstream service and gateway remain authoritative.
permissions.chat_scope: For allowed Chat collection/messages/realtime-auth/events paths, x-session-room-id triggers Session participant/preview checks. Individual conversation lookup requires active Chat membership and matching group room_id, or the source AI branch. Collection filtering retains bound group/AI entries only.
permissions.chat_group_create: Requires session-{room_id} slug and room participant/preview check. Member IDs are rebuilt from Session clients and LMS staff, sorted/deduplicated. Adds chat:manage/read/write only after this branch succeeds.
permissions.chat_ai: Create requires existing composition-backed room. AI path performs conversation lookup and composition room check. This does not prove live model/billing or every membership boundary.
permissions.drm_catalog: Authenticated actor receives drm:composition:read for GET compositions and composition-categories, without a proxy room-membership lookup.
permissions.drm_package: Authenticated actor receives drm:package:read for source-matching GET media/.../packages and packages/.../files/... paths, without a proxy room-membership lookup.
permissions.drm_license: Authenticated actor receives drm:license:read for GET licenses/clearkey prefix, without a proxy room-membership lookup. Resource authorization must be verified in DRM; do not describe these grants as room-bound.

lifecycle_relationships.session_room_id: Session room UUID referenced by settings.room_id; not a Chat conversation ID.
lifecycle_relationships.chat_conversation_id: Chat conversation UUID looked up separately; current membership/org checks belong to Chat.
lifecycle_relationships.member_profile_id: Session room-client profile_id is compared to auth.user_id; canonical IDP mapping must be verified, not inferred from UUID shape.
lifecycle_relationships.lms_classroom_session_id: Optional room link; LMS teacher/support users are queried with forwarded actor; failed staff lookup currently becomes an empty list in the group branch.
lifecycle_relationships.response: Preserves upstream status and allowlisted cache/content/range/x-accel-buffering headers. Does not forward all headers such as Set-Cookie.
lifecycle_relationships.streaming: Chat events suffix and DRM package files forward bytes_stream; other bodies buffer. The SDK helper always requests buffered bytes; explicit client transport is required for streaming.
lifecycle_relationships.chat_collection: Successful scoped collection is parsed as JSON data array and filtered; malformed upstream shape returns502; this transformed response does not retain every original peer header.

pending_acceptance: Actual paired-service current gateway identities/header stripping and namespace selection
Chat room group creation/rejoin, cross-room collection and AI boundaries against actual participants
Actual DRM resource/license checks for delegated path-based permissions
Actual Asset/Profile/LMS success workflows and fallback/configuration isolation
Browser cross-origin preflight with x-session-room-id and native permission headers
SSE/media streaming, cancellation after first bytes and whole-main timeout behavior
prohibited_inferences: Canonical metadata resolution is not deployed source acceptance
Unit tests or transport adapters do not certify actual peer business workflows
The actual Session/Chat paired test uses trusted gateway fixtures, not live IDP authorization

authentication_reconciliation.canonical_defect: Canonical Session enables IDP dev-fallback at compile time. It synthesizes Some(nil UUID) when x-user-id is absent, even with DEV=false. The actual pair red returned403 instead of401.
authentication_reconciliation.repair: Selected production removes default and dev-fallback features; cargo feature tree shows neither. Missing principal then reaches actual Chat as unauthenticated.
